elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner

"this warranty shall apply for 90 days following performance of the Services"
"repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverables or Licensed Software"

elements.element: Express warranties survive the AS IS disclaimer (operative effectiveness)
elements.evidence: "Notwithstanding the foregoing disclaimer, which does not apply to the express warranties in this paragraph"
12 months exceeds the 90-day fallback floor: "for 12 months following delivery"
90 days exceeds the 30-day fallback floor: "for 90 days following performance"
"repair or replacement ... or a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: The document contained only an AS IS disclaimer with no express warranty, so a single concise inserted warranty paragraph is the minimal fix; it does not rewrite or delete the existing disclaimer.

All preferred atomic elements appear expressly: professional manner, workmanlike manner, 12-month conformance of Licensed Software and deliverables to the Documentation, 90-day services period measured from performance, repair, replacement, refund, compliance with laws, and no malicious code.
The carve-out sentence prevents the pre-existing AS IS disclaimer from nullifying the new warranties, avoiding a contradiction or dangling mechanic.

Noted but not a deviation: remedy election sits "at Licensor's option" and refund is limited to "fees paid"; these are minor sub-elements short of ideal customer wording and the coverage of "all other services performed by Licensor" cures any narrow definition of Services.
